result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-around payment processor**\. However, if you're already using Shopify, I'd recommend **Shopify Payments** instead.

The best choice depends on your ecommerce platform, location, and monthly sales.

## My top 5 recommendations

![Stripe | Paiement en ligne |  Blendy expert-comptable digital](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/_jx5fMh3TBOsYzsnN9MZgAeVpFP4hcsG1gqhuwJG4eMgDrmWqs82lA3urpC9AbP2Nvg7TpgFxWieI7uPKInr0ZHsWu9RP_jEnrzZ2DOoqL2uJ7giLgNGrAH0ktACKeDHb7Tmkus9Sl69NkssHUz6EYuc5yTezKvej5KXG1r2osBtNk0UXatCSvdy52J5C4LT?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Easy integration with most ecommerce platforms.
- No monthly processing subscription.
- Excellent fraud prevention and international payment support.
- Good for subscriptions and recurring payments.

Website: [Stripe](https://stripe.com)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify.
- No additional third-party transaction fee.
- Simple order and refund management.
- Shop Pay can make checkout easier.

Website: [Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/ca/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Recognized and trusted by many shoppers.
- Useful as an additional checkout option.
- Supports international customers.
- Can have higher transaction fees.

Website: [PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/ca/business)

---

![Square, Inc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/o-iRI2kybznmyDubdZ44gVK-vjE6gDKLVakQnJxlACGxko3Nj1jIpWaBRdIuWDcPvStz6IZe1O-k-UExmpEW7lDQ_S559qV-l4JT0xhrWDjCbTjdZDVgBDFR6LW32FKPeauHAWGYSuEdhn0AMiHDAZFaPUNLlmIzwiGcOc7OZzuhVnlNs80uSa8gb9GbKVsf?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Great for online and physical stores.
- Combines inventory and payment management.
- Easy to get started.

Website: [Square](https://squareup.com/ca/en)

---

![Top five fintech news stories of the week: 28 August 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Nvwm5m0AvFIyEQCoAUiuiBYsES5Z_TGIIL3a7sg7Vv4eL9Itvfc5xa-EyPsr8IsSKHecG5NYexO0SMIejzwZMML07_ctHuEIL4ButxRVQGAmBUqOEkJLjZgpEozhbgzBigkUW3PNM8qwMbcubKNhZeml3Fh_1lYV5P7aYAnQGGfgg1x4XdQzyp-dffUe_NGw?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Helcim**

- Particularly worth considering for Canadian businesses.
- Interchange-plus pricing.
- Can become cost-effective as transaction volume grows.

Website: [Helcim](https://www.helcim.com/)

## What I would choose

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Starting a small online store | Stripe |
| Using Shopify | Shopify Payments |
| Selling internationally | Stripe + PayPal |
| Selling online and in person | Square |
| Growing Canadian business | Helcim |


Pricing varies by country, card type, and payment method. For example, Stripe's standard Canadian domestic online card pricing is approximately 2.9% + C\$0.30 per transaction.
